playbook:
When the group publicly commits to sealing the full endowment and all receipts so far show everyone contributed 20, I seal 20 tokens each round except possibly the final round.

When it is the final round and all previous rounds showed universal full contributions, I contribute 0 to maximize my personal payoff.

When any player in an early round (before the final) fails to contribute at least half their endowment or otherwise breaks a public agreement, I respond by sealing 0 for every remaining round.

When my envelope is sealed and submitted, I file a receipt that exactly matches the envelope amount (declare truthfully).

When other players have been cooperating but I suspect future retaliation or enforcement that would reduce joint payoffs, I do not deviate until the last round (deviating earlier invites coordinated punishment and reduces my cumulative payoff).

When group signals a credible strategy of permanent punishment after any early defection, I treat that as credible and switch immediately to noncooperation (seal 0).

When I can exploit a unanimously cooperative group only in the final round without causing future consequences, I free-ride in that final round.

Do not underreport or overreport envelope contents — always declare the precise amount; dishonesty is not a viable strategy given receipt checks.
